body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> ERGOTRON introduced a flexible AV rack ''LX Large Display Cart'' during CES 2007. You can simply use hands to change the height of rack without any equipment. It was one of the winners of CES 2007 Innovations award.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
